name: v_badges_for_user
definition:
SELECT u.user_id,
    bc.id AS badge_id,
    bc.code,
    bc.name,
    bc.description,
    bc.icon,
    bc.xp_reward,
    COALESCE(ub.earned_at, NULL::timestamp with time zone) AS earned_at,
    (ub.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS earned
   FROM ((badge_catalog bc
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT auth.uid() AS user_id) u)
     LEFT JOIN user_badges ub ON (((ub.badge_id = bc.id) AND (ub.user_id = u.user_id))))
  WHERE (bc.is_active = true);

name: analytics_social_opt_out_summary
definition:
SELECT count(*) AS total_users,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE social_opt_out) AS total_users_opted_out,
    round(((count(*) FILTER (WHERE social_opt_out))::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric), 4) AS opt_out_rate
   FROM users;

name: analytics_social_opt_out_by_account_age
definition:
SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) THEN '0_7_days'::text
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)) THEN '8_30_days'::text
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '90 days'::interval)) THEN '31_90_days'::text
            ELSE '91_plus_days'::text
        END AS account_age_bucket,
    count(*) AS total_users,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE social_opt_out) AS total_users_opted_out,
    round(((count(*) FILTER (WHERE social_opt_out))::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric), 4) AS opt_out_rate
   FROM users
  GROUP BY
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) THEN '0_7_days'::text
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)) THEN '8_30_days'::text
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '90 days'::interval)) THEN '31_90_days'::text
            ELSE '91_plus_days'::text
        END;

definition:
SELECT crawl_id,
    user_id,
    count(DISTINCT destination_id) AS rated_count
   FROM destination_ratings dr

name: crawl_coverage_public
definition:
SELECT c.crawl_id,
    c.user_id,
    c.route_id,
    c.status,
    c.start_time,
    c.end_time,
    rsc.stop_count,
    COALESCE(rpcu.rated_count, (0)::bigint) AS rated_count,
        CASE
            WHEN (rsc.stop_count > 0) THEN round(((100.0 * (COALESCE(rpcu.rated_count, (0)::bigint))::numeric) / (rsc.stop_count)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS pct_rated
   FROM ((crawl_public c
     JOIN route_stop_counts rsc ON ((rsc.route_id = c.route_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ratings_per_crawl_user rpcu ON (((rpcu.crawl_id = c.crawl_id) AND (rpcu.user_id = c.user_id))))
  WHERE ((c.user_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((c.user_id)::text <> '23898359-306a-4dd3-91f0-da66da19ccfc'::text));

name: crawl_weekly_streak
definition:
WITH weeks AS (
         SELECT crawls.user_id,
            (date_trunc('week'::text, crawls.end_time))::date AS week_start
           FROM crawls
          WHERE ((crawls.end_time IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(crawls.status) = 'completed'::text))
        ), bucket AS (
         SELECT weeks.user_id,
            weeks.week_start,
            1 AS has_crawl
           FROM weeks
          GROUP BY weeks.user_id, weeks.week_start
        ), series AS (
         SELECT b.user_id,
            (generate_series((( SELECT min(b2.week_start) AS min
                   FROM bucket b2
                  WHERE (b2.user_id = b.user_id)))::timestamp with time zone, (( SELECT max(b3.week_start) AS max
                   FROM bucket b3
                  WHERE (b3.user_id = b.user_id)))::timestamp with time zone, '7 days'::interval))::date AS week_start
           FROM bucket b
          GROUP BY b.user_id
        ), joined AS (
         SELECT s.user_id,
            s.week_start,
            COALESCE(b.has_crawl, 0) AS has_crawl
           FROM (series s
             LEFT JOIN bucket b ON (((b.user_id = s.user_id) AND (b.week_start = s.week_start))))
        ), label AS (
         SELECT j.user_id,
            j.week_start,
            j.has_crawl,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (j.has_crawl = 0) THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END) OVER (PARTITION BY j.user_id ORDER BY j.week_start) AS gap_group
           FROM joined j
        )
 SELECT user_id,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM label l2
          WHERE ((l2.user_id = l.user_id) AND (l2.week_start <= (date_trunc('week'::text, now()))::date) AND (l2.gap_group = ( SELECT max(l3.gap_group) AS max
                   FROM label l3
                  WHERE ((l3.user_id = l.user_id) AND (l3.week_start <= (date_trunc('week'::text, now()))::date)))) AND (l2.has_crawl = 1))), (0)::bigint) AS current_streak_weeks
   FROM label l
  GROUP BY user_id;

name: 00_Open_Work
definition:
SELECT source,
    status,
    item_count
   FROM ( SELECT 'user_feedback'::text AS source,
            user_feedback.status,
            (count(*))::integer AS item_count
           FROM user_feedback
          GROUP BY user_feedback.status
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'user_contactus'::text AS source,
            user_contactus.status,
            (count(*))::integer AS item_count
           FROM user_contactus
          GROUP BY user_contactus.status
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'route_submissions'::text AS source,
            route_submissions.status,
            (count(*))::integer AS item_count
           FROM route_submissions
          GROUP BY route_submissions.status) t
  ORDER BY
        CASE status
            WHEN 'new'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'open'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'closed'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END, source;

name: analytics_daily_active_users
definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date AS event_date,
    count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE (user_id IS NOT NULL)) AS signed_in_users,
    count(DISTINCT anonymous_id) FILTER (WHERE ((user_id IS NULL) AND (anonymous_id IS NOT NULL))) AS anonymous_users,
    count(DISTINCT COALESCE((user_id)::text, anonymous_id)) AS active_identities,
    count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
    count(*) AS total_events,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'app_opened'::text)) AS app_opens,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'screen_viewed'::text)) AS screen_views
   FROM user_events
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date)
  ORDER BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date) DESC;

name: analytics_rating_funnel_daily
definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date AS event_date,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_started'::text)) AS rating_started,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_completed'::text)) AS rating_completed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = ANY (ARRAY['rating_abandoned'::text, 'rating_failed'::text, 'rating_validation_failed'::text]))) AS rating_not_completed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_abandoned'::text)) AS rating_abandoned,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_failed'::text)) AS rating_failed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_validation_failed'::text)) AS rating_validation_failed,
    round(((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_completed'::text)))::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_started'::text)), 0))::numeric), 4) AS completion_rate
   FROM user_events
  WHERE (event_name ~~ 'rating_%'::text)
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date)
  ORDER BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date) DESC;

name: analytics_crawl_funnel_daily
definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date AS event_date,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_started'::text)) AS crawl_started,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_viewed'::text)) AS crawl_viewed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_resumed'::text)) AS crawl_resumed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_saved'::text)) AS crawl_saved,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_completed'::text)) AS crawl_completed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_abandoned'::text)) AS crawl_abandoned,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((event_name = 'rating_completed'::text) AND (crawl_id IS NOT NULL))) AS crawl_ratings_completed,
    round(((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_completed'::text)))::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = ANY (ARRAY['crawl_started'::text, 'crawl_resumed'::text, 'crawl_viewed'::text]))), 0))::numeric), 4) AS rough_completion_rate
   FROM user_events
  WHERE ((event_name ~~ 'crawl_%'::text) OR ((event_name = 'rating_completed'::text) AND (crawl_id IS NOT NULL)))
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date)
  ORDER BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date) DESC;

name: analytics_discovery_daily
definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date AS event_date,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'restaurant_search_results_viewed'::text)) AS restaurant_searches_with_results,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'restaurant_search_empty'::text)) AS restaurant_search_empty,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'restaurant_search_failed'::text)) AS restaurant_search_failed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'restaurant_search_result_selected'::text)) AS restaurant_search_result_selected,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'restaurant_profile_viewed'::text)) AS restaurant_profile_views,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'directions_tapped'::text)) AS directions_taps,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'map_opened'::text)) AS map_opens,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = ANY (ARRAY['screen_load_failed'::text, 'api_request_failed'::text, 'external_maps_failed'::text]))) AS failures,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'screen_load_slow'::text)) AS slow_screens
   FROM user_events
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date)
  ORDER BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date) DESC;

name: analytics_route_performance_daily
definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date AS event_date,
    route_id,
    count(DISTINCT COALESCE((user_id)::text, anonymous_id)) AS unique_identities,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = ANY (ARRAY['crawl_viewed'::text, 'crawl_resumed'::text]))) AS crawl_views,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_started'::text)) AS crawl_starts,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_saved'::text)) AS crawl_saves,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'crawl_completed'::text)) AS crawl_completions,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_completed'::text)) AS ratings_completed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'leaderboard_viewed'::text)) AS leaderboard_views
   FROM user_events
  WHERE (route_id IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date), route_id
  ORDER BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date) DESC;

name: analytics_destination_performance_daily
definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date AS event_date,
    destination_id,
    count(DISTINCT COALESCE((user_id)::text, anonymous_id)) AS unique_identities,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'restaurant_profile_viewed'::text)) AS profile_views,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'directions_tapped'::text)) AS directions_taps,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_started'::text)) AS rating_starts,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'rating_completed'::text)) AS rating_completions,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (event_name = 'share_completed'::text)) AS shares
   FROM user_events
  WHERE (destination_id IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date), destination_id
  ORDER BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, occurred_at))::date) DESC;

name: analytics_agent_restaurant_summary
definition:
WITH event_30d AS (
         SELECT user_events.destination_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'restaurant_profile_viewed'::text)) AS profile_views_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'directions_tapped'::text)) AS directions_taps_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'rating_started'::text)) AS rating_starts_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'rating_completed'::text)) AS event_rating_completions_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'share_completed'::text)) AS shares_30d
           FROM user_events
          WHERE ((user_events.destination_id IS NOT NULL) AND (user_events.occurred_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)))
          GROUP BY user_events.destination_id
        ), rating_facts AS (
         SELECT destination_ratings.destination_id,
            count(*) AS rating_count,
            avg(destination_ratings.weight_score) AS avg_weight_score,
            avg(destination_ratings.overall) AS avg_overall,
            max(destination_ratings.created_at) AS last_rated_at
           FROM destination_ratings
          GROUP BY destination_ratings.destination_id
        )
 SELECT d.id AS destination_id,
    d.name AS destination_name,
    d.city,
    d.state_id,
    COALESCE(r.rating_count, (0)::bigint) AS rating_count,
    round(r.avg_weight_score, 2) AS avg_weight_score,
    round(r.avg_overall, 2) AS avg_overall,
    r.last_rated_at,
    COALESCE(e.profile_views_30d, (0)::bigint) AS profile_views_30d,
    COALESCE(e.directions_taps_30d, (0)::bigint) AS directions_taps_30d,
    COALESCE(e.rating_starts_30d, (0)::bigint) AS rating_starts_30d,
    COALESCE(e.event_rating_completions_30d, (0)::bigint) AS event_rating_completions_30d,
    COALESCE(e.shares_30d, (0)::bigint) AS shares_30d
   FROM ((destinations d
     LEFT JOIN rating_facts r ON ((r.destination_id = d.id)))
     LEFT JOIN event_30d e ON ((e.destination_id = d.id)));

name: analytics_agent_route_summary
definition:
WITH event_30d AS (
         SELECT user_events.route_id,
            count(DISTINCT COALESCE((user_events.user_id)::text, user_events.anonymous_id)) AS unique_identities_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = ANY (ARRAY['crawl_viewed'::text, 'crawl_resumed'::text]))) AS crawl_views_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'crawl_started'::text)) AS crawl_starts_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'crawl_completed'::text)) AS crawl_completions_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'rating_completed'::text)) AS ratings_completed_30d
           FROM user_events
          WHERE ((user_events.route_id IS NOT NULL) AND (user_events.occurred_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)))
          GROUP BY user_events.route_id
        ), crawl_facts AS (
         SELECT crawls.route_id,
            count(*) AS all_crawls,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((crawls.status = 'completed'::text) OR (crawls.end_time IS NOT NULL))) AS completed_crawls,
            max(COALESCE(crawls.end_time, crawls.start_time)) AS last_crawl_at
           FROM crawls
          WHERE (crawls.route_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY crawls.route_id
        )
 SELECT r.id AS route_id,
    r.title,
    r.city,
    r.is_public,
    r.is_token_route,
    COALESCE(c.all_crawls, (0)::bigint) AS all_crawls,
    COALESCE(c.completed_crawls, (0)::bigint) AS completed_crawls,
    c.last_crawl_at,
    COALESCE(e.unique_identities_30d, (0)::bigint) AS unique_identities_30d,
    COALESCE(e.crawl_views_30d, (0)::bigint) AS crawl_views_30d,
    COALESCE(e.crawl_starts_30d, (0)::bigint) AS crawl_starts_30d,
    COALESCE(e.crawl_completions_30d, (0)::bigint) AS crawl_completions_30d,
    COALESCE(e.ratings_completed_30d, (0)::bigint) AS ratings_completed_30d
   FROM ((routes r
     LEFT JOIN crawl_facts c ON ((c.route_id = r.id)))
     LEFT JOIN event_30d e ON ((e.route_id = r.id)));

name: analytics_agent_growth_opportunities
definition:
SELECT 'search_empty'::text AS opportunity_type,
    NULL::uuid AS destination_id,
    NULL::uuid AS route_id,
    NULL::integer AS state_id,
    (date_trunc('day'::text, user_events.occurred_at))::date AS event_date,
    count(*) AS signal_count,
    jsonb_build_object('screen', user_events.screen) AS context
   FROM user_events
  WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'restaurant_search_empty'::text)
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, user_events.occurred_at))::date), user_events.screen
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'restaurant_interest_no_rating'::text AS opportunity_type,
    user_events.destination_id,
    NULL::uuid AS route_id,
    NULL::integer AS state_id,
    (date_trunc('day'::text, user_events.occurred_at))::date AS event_date,
    count(*) AS signal_count,
    jsonb_build_object('profile_views', count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'restaurant_profile_viewed'::text)), 'directions_taps', count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'directions_tapped'::text)), 'rating_completions', count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'rating_completed'::text))) AS context
   FROM user_events
  WHERE ((user_events.destination_id IS NOT NULL) AND (user_events.event_name = ANY (ARRAY['restaurant_profile_viewed'::text, 'directions_tapped'::text, 'rating_completed'::text])))
  GROUP BY user_events.destination_id, ((date_trunc('day'::text, user_events.occurred_at))::date)
 HAVING ((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = ANY (ARRAY['restaurant_profile_viewed'::text, 'directions_tapped'::text]))) >= 3) AND (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'rating_completed'::text)) = 0));

name: referral_reporting_daily
definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, COALESCE(a.clicked_at, a.created_at)))::date AS report_date,
    COALESCE(a.source, 'unknown'::text) AS source,
    COALESCE(a.campaign, 'none'::text) AS campaign,
    COALESCE(a.placement, 'unknown'::text) AS placement,
    count(*) AS link_opens,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (a.invitee_user_id IS NOT NULL)) AS attributed_signups,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['qualified'::text, 'rewarded'::text, 'reversed'::text]))) AS qualified_referrals,
    round(((100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['qualified'::text, 'rewarded'::text, 'reversed'::text]))))::numeric) / (NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (a.invitee_user_id IS NOT NULL)), 0))::numeric), 2) AS signup_to_first_rating_percent,
    avg((a.qualified_at - a.signed_up_at)) FILTER (WHERE ((a.qualified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (a.signed_up_at IS NOT NULL))) AS average_time_to_qualification,
    (COALESCE(sum(r.reward_cost_xp), (0)::numeric))::bigint AS reward_cost_xp,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (a.review_status = ANY (ARRAY['flagged'::text, 'under_review'::text, 'rejected'::text]))) AS suspicious_or_rejected
   FROM (referral_attributions a
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT referral_rewards.referral_attribution_id,
            sum(referral_rewards.reward_amount) FILTER (WHERE (referral_rewards.reward_amount > 0)) AS reward_cost_xp
           FROM referral_rewards
          GROUP BY referral_rewards.referral_attribution_id) r ON ((r.referral_attribution_id = a.id)))
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, COALESCE(a.clicked_at, a.created_at)))::date), COALESCE(a.source, 'unknown'::text), COALESCE(a.campaign, 'none'::text), COALESCE(a.placement, 'unknown'::text);

name: referral_funnel_summary
definition:
SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM user_events
          WHERE (user_events.event_name = 'referral_share_completed'::text)) AS invitations_shared,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_attributions
          WHERE (referral_attributions.clicked_at IS NOT NULL)) AS link_opens,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_attributions
          WHERE (referral_attributions.invitee_user_id IS NOT NULL)) AS attributed_signups,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_attributions
          WHERE (referral_attributions.status = ANY (ARRAY['qualified'::text, 'rewarded'::text, 'reversed'::text]))) AS qualified_referrals,
    round(((100.0 * (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_attributions
          WHERE (referral_attributions.status = ANY (ARRAY['qualified'::text, 'rewarded'::text, 'reversed'::text]))))::numeric) / (NULLIF(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_attributions
          WHERE (referral_attributions.invitee_user_id IS NOT NULL)), 0))::numeric), 2) AS signup_to_first_rating_percent,
    ( SELECT avg((referral_attributions.qualified_at - referral_attributions.signed_up_at)) AS avg
           FROM referral_attributions
          WHERE ((referral_attributions.qualified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (referral_attributions.signed_up_at IS NOT NULL))) AS average_time_to_qualification,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(referral_rewards.reward_amount), (0)::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM referral_rewards
          WHERE (referral_rewards.reward_amount > 0)) AS reward_cost_xp,
    (( SELECT COALESCE(avg(q.referral_count), (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM ( SELECT (count(*))::numeric AS referral_count
                   FROM referral_attributions
                  WHERE (referral_attributions.status = ANY (ARRAY['qualified'::text, 'rewarded'::text, 'reversed'::text]))
                  GROUP BY referral_attributions.inviter_user_id) q))::numeric(12,2) AS qualified_referrals_per_inviter,
    ( SELECT (user_events.metadata ->> 'placement'::text)
           FROM user_events
          WHERE ((user_events.event_name = 'referral_share_completed'::text) AND (user_events.metadata ? 'placement'::text))
          GROUP BY (user_events.metadata ->> 'placement'::text)
          ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS top_share_placement,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_attributions
          WHERE ((referral_attributions.status = 'rejected'::text) OR (referral_attributions.review_status = ANY (ARRAY['flagged'::text, 'under_review'::text, 'rejected'::text])))) AS rejected_or_suspicious,
    round(((100.0 * (( SELECT count(DISTINCT a.invitee_user_id) AS count
           FROM referral_attributions a
          WHERE ((a.qualified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM destination_ratings dr
                  WHERE ((dr.user_id = a.invitee_user_id) AND (dr.created_at >= (a.qualified_at + '7 days'::interval))))))))::numeric) / (NULLIF(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM referral_attributions
          WHERE (referral_attributions.qualified_at IS NOT NULL)), 0))::numeric), 2) AS referred_user_7d_return_percent;

name: buffacoin_rating_reconciliation
definition:
SELECT o.operation_id,
    ((l.id IS NOT NULL) AND (l.delta = (- o.coin_cost))) AS debit_matches,
    ((r.id IS NOT NULL) AND (r.user_id = o.user_id) AND (r.crawl_id = o.crawl_id)) AS rating_matches,
    ((c.crawl_id IS NOT NULL) AND (c.user_id = o.user_id)) AS crawl_matches
   FROM (((buffacoin_rating_operations o
     LEFT JOIN buffacoin_ledger l ON ((l.id = o.debit_ledger_id)))
     LEFT JOIN destination_ratings r ON ((r.id = o.rating_id)))
     LEFT JOIN crawls c ON ((c.crawl_id = o.crawl_id)));

name: social_feed_v2
definition:
SELECT ('rating:'::text || (dr.id)::text) AS event_id,
    'restaurant_rating'::text AS event_type,
    dr.user_id,
    u.username,
    u.avatar_url,
    dr.created_at AS occurred_at,
    dr.id AS rating_id,
    d.id AS subject_id,
    d.name AS subject_name,
    d.city AS subject_town,
    d.state_id AS subject_state_id,
    dr.weight_score AS score,
    COALESCE(dr.is_buffacoin, false) AS is_buffacoin,
    NULL::integer AS stop_count
   FROM ((destination_ratings dr
     JOIN destinations d ON ((d.id = dr.destination_id)))
     JOIN users u ON ((u.user_id = dr.user_id)))
  WHERE can_user_appear_socially(dr.user_id)
UNION ALL
 SELECT ('crawl_completed:'::text || (c.crawl_id)::text) AS event_id,
    'crawl_completed'::text AS event_type,
    c.user_id,
    u.username,
    u.avatar_url,
    COALESCE(c.end_time, c.start_time) AS occurred_at,
    NULL::uuid AS rating_id,
    c.crawl_id AS subject_id,
    COALESCE(r.title, 'Wing crawl'::text) AS subject_name,
    COALESCE(r.city, first_stop.city) AS subject_town,
    first_stop.state_id AS subject_state_id,
    NULL::numeric AS score,
    false AS is_buffacoin,
    ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM unnest(ARRAY[r.stop1_id, r.stop2_id, r.stop3_id, r.stop4_id, r.stop5_id]) stop_id(stop_id)
          WHERE (stop_id.stop_id IS NOT NULL)) AS stop_count
   FROM (((crawls c
     JOIN users u ON ((u.user_id = c.user_id)))
     LEFT JOIN routes r ON ((r.id = c.route_id)))
     LEFT JOIN destinations first_stop ON ((first_stop.id = r.stop1_id)))
  WHERE ((c.status = 'completed'::text) AND (c.end_time IS NOT NULL) AND can_user_appear_socially(c.user_id));

name: v_social_feed
definition:
SELECT dr.user_id,
    dr.weight_score,
    dr.created_at,
    d.id AS destination_id,
    d.name AS destination_name,
    d.city AS destination_city,
    d.state_id AS destination_state_id,
    u.username,
    dr.id AS rating_id,
    u.avatar_url
   FROM ((destination_ratings dr
     JOIN destinations d ON ((d.id = dr.destination_id)))
     JOIN users u ON ((u.user_id = dr.user_id)))
  WHERE can_user_appear_socially(dr.user_id);

name: buffaverse_event_feed
definition:
SELECT id,
    event_type_id,
    event_type_version,
    lifecycle_status,
    geographic_scope,
    state_id,
    geography_key,
    starts_at,
    ends_at,
    progress_model,
    progress_target,
    reward_reference_kind,
    reward_reference_key,
    title,
    summary,
    display_metadata,
    updated_at
   FROM buffaverse_event_instances event
  WHERE ((lifecycle_status = ANY (ARRAY['scheduled'::text, 'active'::text])) AND (ends_at > now()))
  ORDER BY
        CASE lifecycle_status
            WHEN 'active'::text THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END, starts_at, id;

name: buffaverse_admin_event_visibility
definition:
SELECT event.id,
    event.event_type_id,
    event.event_type_version,
    event.lifecycle_status,
    event.geographic_scope,
    event.state_id,
    event.geography_key,
    event.starts_at,
    event.ends_at,
    event.feature_flag_key,
    flag.enabled AS feature_flag_enabled,
    event.source,
    event.correlation_id,
    event.created_at,
    event.updated_at,
    ( SELECT max(history.occurred_at) AS max
           FROM buffaverse_event_lifecycle_history history
          WHERE (history.event_instance_id = event.id)) AS last_transition_at,
    ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM buffaverse_event_lifecycle_history history
          WHERE (history.event_instance_id = event.id)) AS transition_count
   FROM (buffaverse_event_instances event
     JOIN buffaverse_feature_flags flag ON ((flag.flag_key = event.feature_flag_key)));

name: mango_pending_restaurants
definition:
SELECT id,
    user_id,
    state_id,
    restaurant_name,
    address,
    created_at,
    verification_evidence
   FROM destination_suggestions s
  WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM restaurant_suggestion_reviews r
          WHERE (r.suggestion_id = s.id))));
